notes: Studio has a DJ Mode card. The turntable rig was reachable only from the DJ MODE button under the player; it now sits with the rest of the creative tools, first in the Studio rack, and opens the same deck it always did.

Nothing about the deck changed: the platter and the scratch, pitch and speed, the EQ and its kill switches, the hot cues, the beat repeat, the FX pads, the crossfader and the loop controls are exactly as they were.
The card tells the truth about where it is: it says when the rig is already open, and it says outright when the playlist you are playing from has DJ Mode switched off, instead of opening nothing.
The built-in assistant stopped answering a question with the wrong entry. Ask it how to make the library smaller and it answers about Compress library, which is the real feature in the real place.

The reason was the matcher behind it: two and three letter fragments of an answer counted as hits, so the letters inside can and compact scored a playlist share-code entry. A short fragment can no longer carry a match on its own.
The DJ Mode answer in the built-in chat is right now too. It described an autoplay the app does not have; it describes the deck, where it opens, and what is on it.
